title: IngestResponse
description: Response for a document ingestion job.

warnings.description: Caller-safe notes on a job that completed with a caveat (#847): e.g. `symbol_glossary_degraded: 2 of 40 document(s) (timeout=2) endpoint host:port` when the glossary step's model half degraded for some documents (they carry the rules glossary). Labels, counts and host:port only, never a raw message or a credential. Optional: an implementation that records none may omit it.

collection.description: The collection this job actually targets. Only meaningful when the request omitted `collection` — that is the case where the SERVER chose. The id is always one from the caller's own GET /v1/collections listing, so echoing it discloses nothing.
